method: Untruncated2801..3400 read and original pinned XXH32 compiled with local clang -O2 into private test harness. XXH64 only memory-helper prefix read; no whole-file credit.
findings: XXH32 consumes16-byte stripes and finalizes0..15 bytes through four-byte then single-byte tails; optional switch path is separate compile configuration. Size optimization2 may route single-shot via streaming.
Streaming completes buffered stripe before consuming remaining full stripes; large_len remains set across32-bit total-length wrap. This control does not exercise4GiB wrap.
NULL-input update returnsOK after asserting length0; it is a documented precondition, not supported nonzero-length error recovery. No invalid-pointer misuse executed.
Digest reads state without modifying it; copyState uses memcpy and requires nonoverlap. Canonical32-bit output swaps little-endian native hash then copies bytes; inverse reads big-endian.

checks: Each prefix streaming digest equals original single-shot.
Repeated digest and copied-state digest equal prefix.
Canonical roundtrip and exact big-endian bytes.
NULL+zero update and NULL+zero one-shot equivalence.
